concerns.text: T008a mandates 'HALT EXECUTION' if manual ground truth is missing and forbids synthetic data. This contradicts plan.md (Phase 0 T001/T003b) and spec.md (FR-007/Edge Cases) which require a fallback 'Methodological Validation' using mock data if the real dataset is unavailable. The task creates a hard blocking condition that prevents the project from proceeding if AlayaWorld data is not pre-provided, violating the spec's contingency logic.

T023 implements an Augmented Dickey-Fuller (ADF) test for stationarity before the Wilcoxon test. This directly contradicts plan.md (Statistical Methodology section) and spec.md (FR-006) logic; the plan explicitly states the ADF test was 'Removed' because it is 'statistically invalid for bounded, discrete frame-level error series'. Implementing a removed/invalid test violates the approved statistical methodology.

T027 instructs the system to 'Fail the run if peak RAM > 7 GB'. Spec.md (US-3/SC-003) and plan.md (Constitution Check Principle VII) define these as measurement constraints for reporting and validation, not a hard runtime exit code that aborts the experiment. Aborting the run prevents the generation of the required resource log evidence needed to prove compliance or non-compliance, violating the spec's requirement to 'log' and 'exit with code 2' only for validation failures, not resource overages during execution.

T012 requires implementing a fallback to a specific HuggingFace model (Stable Video Diffusion) if AlayaWorld is missing. Spec.md (Assumptions) and plan.md (Dataset Variable Fit) assume the AlayaWorld dataset/model exists or will be locally provided. Introducing an external, unverified substitute model violates Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) and Principle VI (Deterministic Symbolic Grounding) because the fallback model's behavior and 'drift' characteristics are not part of the research hypothesis or the 'Verified datasets' block.

T014a calculates 'Mean F1-score (IoU > 0.5)' for Ground Truth Validation. Spec.md (FR-003) defines the validation metric simply as 'accuracy' without specifying IoU or F1. Using a metric not explicitly defined in the spec creates a testability ambiguity where the 'pass' condition (≥85%) cannot be strictly verified against the spec's original wording, potentially weakening the requirement's semantic intent.

T019 implements a 'paired t-test' for User Story 2. The spec (FR-006/SC-004) and plan (Statistical Methodology) explicitly mandate a 'Wilcoxon signed-rank test' (non-parametric) due to the nature of the data. The existence of T019 suggests a conflicting testing strategy that contradicts the statistical rigor defined in the plan and spec, potentially leading to incorrect validation logic if T019 is used as the primary check.
